Joy humein jitna milna chahiye usse zyada milne ka ehsas hai.
Azadi mazboot hai.
Joy ek shukraguzar rooh ki meethi awaaz hai.
Joy paon se border cross karna hai.
Khushi azaad aatma ki khushboo hai.
Khushi mazaa hai.
Azadi aasaan hai.
Azaadi theek karne wali hai.
Khushi andar se aati hai, bahar se nahi.
Azadi mein jiyo, roshni mein jiyo.
Khushi aaram hai.
Azadi mann ki shakti hai.
Khushi aantarik dhun hai.
Wander karna matlab sach mein zinda rehna hai.
Khushi achanak milne wali cheez nahi; yeh ek chunav hai.
Khushi farishton ki bhasha hai.
Khushi dheemi hai.
Azadi apni marzi se jeene ka haq hai.
Khushi baarish hai.
Chamakti khushi Bhagwan ki maujoodgi ka sanket hai.
Azadi rashtron ka garv hai.
Khushi insaan ka asli swabhav hai.
Azadi bandhan mukt hona hai.
Azadi sangharsh hai.
Azadi ek mehnat se mila inaam hai.
Azaadi hi ekmatra lakshya hai.
Insaan barabar hain; janam nahi gun fark banata hai.
Khushi pyar hai.
Azaadi sabse badi shakti hai.
Khushi chodi hai.
